brief:
A UK Jewish organization has filed a legal challenge against the government's designation of Hamas as a terrorist organization, the Middle East Eye reported. The Jewish Network for Palestine argues the proscription has been used to intimidate and silence pro-Palestine activists, including Jewish supporters of Palestinian rights.

The group contends that the terror designation extends beyond Hamas's military wing to restrict lawful political speech and activism related to Palestine.
